svg.text: Request 6: Corrected Clock-Sector Leave-One-Out Gamma Fit
The observable now matches the potential-only clock EFT, and masses are inferred from non-gamma PK information only.
System-by-system pulls at the clock-only posterior mean
Prior-box scale check (zeta box x4): eta(sbar) grows x1.67 [data-limited]; zeta1/zeta2/kappa_* grow x3.88/x4.04/x3.74 and the Bayes factor grows x0.27 [box-limited].
Only eta(sbar) is a data-driven constraint; the zeta marginals, kappa_*, and the Bayes factors track the flat zeta prior box.
